Benefits & Perks

Support for Your Work, Growth, and Well-Being.

BigID supports employees with competitive rewards, flexibility, professional development, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities to build meaningful relationships across the company.

Competitive Compensation

Competitive salaries and equity opportunities designed to recognize employee impact.

Comprehensive Benefits

Benefits that support employees and their families, subject to local plans and eligibility.

Remote Flexibility

Flexible and remote-work opportunities across many teams, roles, and regions.

Time to Recharge

Flexible hours and generous paid time off to support sustainable performance.

Professional Growth

Learning opportunities, development, mentorship, and access to LinkedIn Learning.

Team Connection

Company events, team gatherings, and shared experiences that help colleagues connect.

Our Company Values

Care, Do, Try & Shine.

Our values guide how we collaborate, innovate, support one another, and create positive outcomes for customers and communities.

Care

Care about the world, one another, our customers, and doing work that matters.

Do

Take ownership, make a positive impact, and become a catalyst for meaningful progress.

Try

Explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, learn quickly, and rebuild better than before.

Shine

Celebrate differences, recognize progress, support others, and bring your strengths to the team.

Employee Experience

Learn, Collaborate, and Make a Visible Impact.

Work With Smart, Supportive People Who Want You to Succeed.

BigID employees describe a collaborative environment where people share ideas, answer questions, support growth, and take ownership of work that can influence the company and its customers.

Supportive Collaboration

Work with colleagues who share knowledge and make time to help others succeed.

Cross-Functional Access

Connect with teams and leaders across functions, geographies, and levels of seniority.

Meaningful Ownership

Contribute ideas, make decisions, and see how your work affects products, customers, and growth.

Continuous Learning

Build skills through mentorship, challenging projects, and professional-development opportunities.
